title: Top Problems on Prefix Sum Technique for Interviews - GeeksforGeeks
content:
The Prefix Sum Technique is a powerful and widely used approach in coding interviews, especially for optimizing queries related to subarray sums and cumulative computations.

Easy Problems

  • Equilibrium Index
  • Split an array into two equal Sum subarrays
  • Mean of range in array
  • Original Array from Prefix Sums

Medium and Hard Problems

  • Product of Array Except Self
  • Longest Subarray With Sum K
  • Minimum Removals for Target Sum
  • Subarray with 0 sum
  • Longest Span in two Binary Arrays
  • Largest Submatrix With Sum 0
  • Maximum occurring integer in given ranges
  • Compute before Matrix
  • Maximum occured integer
  • Longest Span with same Sum in two Binary arrays
  • Maximum sum Rectangle
  • Subarray Sum Divisible By K
  • Count Subarrays having Sum K
  • Smallest sum contiguous subarray
